name: p-calendar-5
title: Calendar 5
description: Calendar with custom Select dropdown for month/year

files.content:
<script lang="ts">
  import { CalendarDate, getLocalTimeZone, today } from '@internationalized/date';
  import { Calendar } from '$lib/components/ui/calendar';

  let value = $state(today(getLocalTimeZone()));

  const minValue = new CalendarDate(1930, 1, 1);
  const maxValue = new CalendarDate(2030, 12, 31);
  const years = Array.from(
    { length: maxValue.year - minValue.year + 1 },
    (_, i) => minValue.year + i
  );
</script>

<Calendar bind:value captionLayout="dropdown" {maxValue} {minValue} mode="single" {years} />
